# Quick Start

The employee mesh is a working ReAct agent: a natural language question arrives, the agent generates SQL, the SQL tool executes it against SQLite, the result comes back, the agent answers. Five actors. One bus. Full PII tokenisation.

## Prerequisites

```sh
# Debian/Ubuntu
sudo apt install libnng-dev liblmdb-dev libcurl4-openssl-dev libsqlite3-dev libncursesw5-dev

# Fedora/RHEL
sudo dnf install nng-devel lmdb-devel libcurl-devel sqlite-devel ncurses-devel
```

If your distro doesn't package nng, vendor it:

```sh
git submodule add https://github.com/nanomsg/nng.git vendor/nng
cd vendor/nng && mkdir build && cd build && cmake .. && make -j$(nproc)
# add -Ivendor/nng/include -Lvendor/nng/build to CFLAGS/LIBS
```

An OpenAI-compatible LLM API (DeepSeek, OpenAI, or local Ollama):

```sh
# DeepSeek (recommended) — get a key at platform.deepseek.com
export LLM_API_KEY=sk-...
export LLM_MODEL=deepseek-chat

# Or local Ollama
export LLM_BASE_URL=http://localhost:11434
export LLM_MODEL=gemma4:e2b
```

ONNX Runtime (for PII NER filtering):

```sh
# Fedora/RHEL
sudo dnf install onnxruntime-devel

# Debian/Ubuntu — not in apt, install from upstream release:
curl -L https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/releases/download/v1.20.1/onnxruntime-linux-x64-1.20.1.tgz \
  | tar xz -C /tmp
sudo mkdir -p /usr/include/onnxruntime
sudo cp -r /tmp/onnxruntime-linux-x64-1.20.1/include/* /usr/include/onnxruntime/
sudo cp /tmp/onnxruntime-linux-x64-1.20.1/lib/*.so* /usr/lib/
sudo ldconfig
```

Python (for build tools only — the mesh itself is pure C):

```sh
pip install msgpack  # needed by export scripts
```

## Build

```sh
# 1. Build the runtime (actor + proxy)
make

# 2. Build the employee-mesh demo (client, TUI, handlers)
cd examples/employee-mesh
make all
```

This produces:

```
actor                  — runtime binary
proxy                  — bus proxy (~57 lines)
examples/employee-mesh/
  client               — CLI query tool
  tui                  — ncurses chat interface
  handlers/
    llm-agent          — ReAct agent (Ollama + LMDB)
    sqlite-tool        — SQLite query executor
    pii-filter         — NER mask/restore (ONNX)
```

## Run

```sh
cd examples/employee-mesh
make run LLM_API_KEY=sk-... LLM_MODEL=deepseek-chat
```

This starts 5 processes:

| Process | Topic subscription | Role |
|---------|-------------------|------|
| `proxy` | — | Bus fanout (:5556/:5557) |
| `tokenise-1` | `user_message`, `sql_result` | Mask PII before LLM |
| `detokenise-1` | `sql_query_masked`, `agent_response_masked` | Restore PII after LLM |
| `sqlite-tool-1` | `sql_query` | Execute SQL |
| `llm-agent-1` | `user_message_masked`, `sql_result_masked` | ReAct agent (OpenAI-compatible LLM) |

## Query

```sh
make query Q="who manages the Development department?"
```

Or use the client directly:

```sh
./client "how many employees in Development?"
```

## Chat

```sh
make chat
```

Opens the ncurses TUI. Type a question and press Enter. The agent explores the database, runs queries, and answers. Session history persists across turns in LMDB.

## Stop

```sh
make stop
```

Kills all mesh processes and wipes LMDB state.

## Pipeline

```{mermaid}
sequenceDiagram
  participant C  as client
  participant TK as tokenise
  participant AG as llm-agent
  participant DK as detokenise
  participant DB as sqlite-tool

  C  ->> TK : user_message
  Note over TK: mask PII → tokens
  TK ->> AG : user_message_masked
  AG ->> DK : sql_query_masked
  Note over DK: restore names in SQL
  DK ->> DB : sql_query
  DB ->> TK : sql_result
  Note over TK: mask employee data
  TK ->> AG : sql_result_masked
  AG ->> DK : agent_response_masked
  Note over DK: restore answer
  DK ->> C  : agent_response
```

The LLM never sees real PII. Everything entering its context is tokenised (`TOK_PERSON_0001`). Everything it emits is detokenised before reaching the user or database. See @agents for the full PII Token Bubble design.

## Configuration

All behaviour is controlled by environment variables. See @appendix for the complete reference. The key ones:

```sh
# LLM backend (OpenAI-compatible)
LLM_BASE_URL=https://api.deepseek.com   # or http://localhost:11434 for Ollama
LLM_API_KEY=sk-...                      # not needed for Ollama
LLM_MODEL=deepseek-chat                 # or gemma4:e2b for Ollama

# PII filtering
NER_MODEL_PATH=models/ner.onnx
TOKENMAP_PATH=/tmp/actor-mesh/tokenmap
```

## Troubleshooting

**"No such file: handlers/pii-filter"** — run `make all` to build all handlers.

**"mdb_env_open: No such file or directory"** — the tokenmap directory wasn't created. `make run` should create it; if running actors manually, ensure `TOKENMAP_PATH` exists.

**Client times out** — the ReAct loop can take 30-90 seconds with a local model. The client has a 10-minute timeout. For Ollama, check it is running: `curl http://localhost:11434/api/tags`. For remote APIs, verify your key with `curl https://api.deepseek.com/v1/models -H "Authorization: Bearer $LLM_API_KEY"`.

**Port already in use** — `make stop` or `pkill proxy` to free ports 5556/5557.
